label: Received at 3PL — any family
notes: One template, three source files: the Haptic, Octo and Driveri received sheets have an identical 5-column header, so this is family-independent.
device_id here refers to devices that already exist from a previous load, so this template consumes the ids of a prior run rather than generating new ones.
The source sheets disagree on the date format for Date Received (2024-11-22 vs 28-03-2025). This follows the column name and writes YYYY-MM-DD.
